question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated object-identical alias for shipped plugins, and what compatibility window should that alias have?
rationale: The code change is a narrow repair for a shipped plugin SDK break, but adding back a public runtime name is a maintainer-owned API compatibility decision.

options.title: Restore deprecated alias
options.body: Accept the compatibility contract, rebase the branch, and land the object-identical alias while keeping `channel.inbound.*` as the documented canonical path.

options.title: Reject core alias
options.body: Require affected plugin authors to republish against `channel.inbound.*`, accepting that older compiled plugins remain broken on newer cores.

options.title: Pause for API plan
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define a broader plugin SDK deprecation policy and removal timeline.

recommendation.title: Restore deprecated alias
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility contract, rebase the branch, and land the object-identical alias while keeping `channel.inbound.*` as the documented canonical path.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest visible history on the plugin-runtime/channel SDK seam being changed.
